trans.sense: front part of an insect's head or a spider's cephalothorax

examples.text: Cuisinart stuck a human eyelash to his clypeus with saliva, twisted it into a handlebar mustache, and greeted citizens as they arrived at the rim of the sink.
examples.ref: 1990, Daniel Evan Weiss, The Roaches Have No King (Serpent's Tail 2001, p.16)

examples.text: When viewed from the front, the part of the carapace between the anterior eyes and the front edge of the carapace is called the clypeus.
examples.ref: 1996, Michael J. Roberts, Spiders of Britain and Northern Europe (Collins 1996, p. 14)
